name: Angela Jones
title: Parent Partner
quote: Parent leadership matters because we are the essential part of our story. We are the beginning of the setting, working through our plots of life with conflicts and, most importantly, solutions.
project: Community Needs Assessment: Overdose and Addiction in the Worcester Community

name: Anthony Henderson
title: Parent Leader
project: Brockton Devoted Dads: a needs assessment grounded in the fathers Anthony supports through the Devoted Dads and Nurturing Fathers groups, recommending a community health worker approach that helps fathers navigate court, housing, childcare, and work barriers.

name: Eneida Molina
title: Parent Leader
quote: Parenting has taught me patience, resilience, and the importance of listening. For me, parent leadership is about serving with humility, learning from others, and working together to make a positive difference.
project: Diabetes in Low-Income Communities, with Maria Vargas, in Springfield and Roxbury

name: Hanan Lahmouch
title: Parent Partner
quote: When we invest in parent leadership, we validate the lived expertise of families and build stronger, more responsive systems from the ground up. True community health starts by trusting parents as the experts of their own experiences.

name: Huong Vu
title: Family Engagement Specialist
quote: Parent leadership, to me, is about seeing parents as more than just people who use services. They're experts from their own lived experience and should have an important role in decisions that impact their families.

name: Kennysha Wrencher
title: Parent Leader
quote: Parent leadership matters because parents are the experts on their own children and communities. When their voices are valued and included, we build stronger families, more responsive systems, and better outcomes for the next generation.
project: Talking With Our Children About Growing Up: puberty and menstrual health conversations in Dorchester, Roxbury, and Mattapan

name: Kristi Hyacinthe
title: Parent Partner
quote: Parent leadership gives families a voice and helps ensure that decisions are made with families, not just for families.
project: Addressing Mental Health Disparities Among Low-Income, Uninsured, and Minority Populations in Boston

name: Lai Dao
title: Parent Partner
quote: To me, being a parent leader means always being ready to stand alongside other parents. Sometimes, simply having someone who understands and offers support can make a world of difference.

name: Liang (Shirley) Cao
title: Parent Leader
quote: I've learned that leadership isn't about how much you can do, but how you connect with others. Sometimes, a little shadow puppet can build a bridge between different cultures and communities.
project: Shadow Puppetry in the Community: Building Cultural Bridges

name: Maria Vargas
title: Parent Leader
quote: As a mother and a child care provider, I have seen that when parents are empowered, listened to, and involved, they strengthen families, inspire positive change, and help create brighter futures for all children.
project: Diabetes in Low-Income Communities, with Eneida Molina, in Springfield and Roxbury

name: Maureen Greenaway
title: Parent Leader
quote: As a parent leader you turn struggles into strength and pain into purpose so you can lead with love, determination, resilience and courage.
project: Heart Health in Our Communities: raising awareness of cardiovascular disease

name: Naoual Sahel
title: Parent Partner
quote: Parents are experts in their own lived experiences and understand what families need to thrive. When we elevate their voices and create space for them to lead, we build stronger families, stronger communities, and stronger systems.

name: Nicole Pola
title: Parent Partner
quote: The best leaders inspire change in the world, but the greatest leaders inspire it first at home.
project: Nourishing Our Community: a community needs assessment on food insecurity

name: Peace Junaid
title: Parent Partner
quote: Parent leadership feels like going on a journey and extending a hand on the way to others where it matters most to them.

name: Samantha Wu-Topolski
title: Parent Partner
quote: Every parent has a unique story, lived experience, and voice that deserves to be heard. When we create space and a path for parents to lead, we build stronger communities and create better opportunities for every child to thrive.

name: Yu Kwan (Angel) Mok
title: Preschool Teacher
quote: My parent leadership journey is rooted in the belief that parents are powerful voices and essential partners in creating positive change.
project: Improving Early Childhood Literacy and School Readiness Among Preschool Children (Ages 3–5) at Melrose Day Care Center

name: Zenaida Gonzalez
title: Parent Leader
quote: Parents are the pillars of their children's lives, providing the foundation, guidance, and strength they need to build a brighter future.
project: Food Insecurity Among Boston Public Schools Families
